verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a system-level package manager for installing tools and apps (formulae, casks, Brewfiles). It has no concept of monorepo workspace packages, so filtering installs and scripts to a subset of workspace packages, or to those affected by a change, is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Homebrew shipping workspace or affected-package filtering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)
